environment.transport: Fastify.inject; authenticated HTTP handlers, no socket/network

dataset.fixture: DEMO-US-A copied under 100 distinct synthetic instrument IDs

methodology.candidatesCold: first request after instrument metadata mutation, same process; not OS/process cold
methodology.candidatesWarm: immediate second request with unchanged database; does not assume an application result cache
methodology.replay: replayPlan from persisted verified synthetic bars through file-backed SQLite WAL/FULL transaction completion, including SQLite synchronization calls
methodology.audit: read persisted decision_inputs, parse and auditDecisionInput; assert MATCH and no SQLite changes
methodology.setupExcluded: login, fixture insertion, support-plan creation/versioning, risk activation, feedback and release

limits: All instruments, market bars and attempts are synthetic; no provider credentials or external requests.

Single process, serial requests and temporary file-backed SQLite with WAL/FULL; includes configured database synchronization calls but not a physical power-loss/durability proof or a production-disk benchmark.
Socket/network transport, browser rendering, concurrent production load and provider latency are not measured.
Cold timings invalidate application results only; JIT and operating-system caches can remain warm.
Historical replay throughput does not establish live receipt-to-alert latency or upstream continuity.
No live capability, production readiness or trading profitability claim.
